uncited: It differs from sibling methods by serving as the foundational rasterization mechanism for feature accumulation; while siblings like LangSplat or LSeg Feature Encoding apply specific encoders or decoding heads, this article defines the core differentiable alpha-blending accumulation of arbitrary feature vectors $\mathbf{f}_i \in \mathbb{R}^d$ that underpins the entire family, building on the shared principles of [Semantic and Language Embeddings](8130-semantic-and-language-embeddings.md).
It is chosen when scale-dependent semantic consistency is required, such as in multi-scale segmentation tasks.
It differs from standard feature accumulation by introducing a gating factor that multiplies the accumulated feature.
